Title: Rehgar Patch
Subtitle: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.31360 (July 23, 2014, article 14742016) adding playable Hero Rehgar, Shaman of the Earthen Ring, to the Nexus.
Highlights: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.31360 (July 23, 2014, article 14742016) adding playable Hero Rehgar, Shaman of the Earthen Ring, to the Nexus.
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Rehgar, Shaman of the Earthen Ring:
  • - Trait — Ghost Wolf (Z): Transforms Rehgar into a Ghost Wolf instead of using a mount, increasing Movement Speed.
  • - Chain Heal (Q): Creates a healing wave that jumps between allies.
  • - Lightning Shield (W): Imbues a target ally with lightning, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
  • - Earthbind Totem (E): Spawns a totem that slows nearby enemies.
  • - Bloodlust (R): Stirs allies into a frenzy, increasing their Attack and Movement Speeds.
  • - Ancestral Healing (R): Significantly heals an allied Hero.
